column1: # spec/calc/calc_vectors.tsv -- LOCKED golden vectors of the Calculator desk
# accessory (bead initech-tdnl.17; CLAUDE.md Rule 8). Each row is ONE key
# sequence typed into the REAL Mac OS 8.1 Calculator under Basilisk II from a
# cleared calculator, and the 12-character readout the capture shows after it.
# goldens/captures/<capture>.png, the readout interior at screen x 276..359,
# y 121..138). Transcribed BY HAND from the captures -- never from InitechOS
# (Law 2: the oracle's expectation is the real Mac, not the artifact).
# harness/proptest/test_calc.c also re-reads every capture (when the corpus is
# present) and grades the transcription pixel-exact through the locked
# readout strike, so a mistyped row cannot hide.
# keys: 0-9 . + - * / = as typed; c / C the clear key (letter); K the Mac
#   keypad Clear (Basilisk: NumLock); E keypad Enter; R Return; X Escape;
#   B Backspace. q16 (R ignored) is a MAC-ONLY row: the PC cooks Return and
#   keypad Enter to ONE message (os/flair/event.c), so InitechOS's keyboard
#   map sends both to '=' (calc_core.h); the row is graded at the COMMAND
#   level (R -> no command), not through the PC key map.
